name: Email inbox
description: Connect your support inbox: forward support@ emails to Hay.chat and let the AI reply by email, threaded like a normal conversation. The AI can also email your team.

send-email.label: Send email to your team
send-email.description: Email the store's team (the notification addresses, or the support address) — for example when a customer needs a person

supportAddress.label: Your support address
supportAddress.description: The address your customers already write to, e.g. support@yourstore.com. You will forward this mailbox to the Hay.chat address shown below.

storeName.label: Sender name
storeName.description: Shown as the sender of Hay.chat's replies, e.g. "Acme Support". Defaults to your workspace name.

bccArchive.label: Keep a copy in my inbox
bccArchive.description: BCC your support address on every reply Hay.chat sends, so your mailbox holds the whole conversation.

notificationRecipients.label: Team notification addresses
notificationRecipients.description: Comma-separated addresses the AI's "Send email to your team" action writes to, e.g. when a customer needs a person. Defaults to your support address.

ui.title: Connect your inbox
ui.intro: Keep your support address. Forward it to Hay.chat and the AI answers by email — every reply stays in the same thread, and you can take over any conversation from the dashboard.

statusError.title: Couldn't load the email channel status
statusError.body: Make sure the plugin is enabled and its settings are saved, then try again.
statusError.noApi: The dashboard API is not available in this view.

notReady.title: Email channel is not available on this Hay.chat installation yet
notReady.body: The host is missing: {missing}. Ask your Hay.chat administrator to configure inbound email.

needsAddress.title: Save your support address first
needsAddress.body: Enter the address your customers write to in the settings above and save. Hay.chat uses it to recognise forwarded mail and to send the right Reply-To.

address.title: Your Hay.chat forwarding address
address.intro: Forward your support mailbox to this address. It is unique to your workspace.
address.replyTo: Replies ask to be answered at
address.archiveOn: On — every reply is BCC'd to {address}
address.archiveOff: Off — enable "Keep a copy in my inbox" above if you want them

gmail.title: Gmail or Google Workspace
gmail.body: Open Gmail as the support mailbox → Settings → See all settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP → Add a forwarding address → paste the Hay.chat address → Next. Google emails Hay.chat a confirmation code; it appears below within a minute. Enter it in Gmail, choose "Forward a copy of incoming mail" and save.

outlook.title: Outlook or Microsoft 365
outlook.body: Open Outlook on the web as the support mailbox → Settings → Mail → Forwarding → Enable forwarding → paste the Hay.chat address → tick "Keep a copy of forwarded messages" → Save. Some Microsoft 365 tenants need an admin to allow external forwarding.

other.title: Other providers
other.body: Any mailbox that can auto-forward works. Forward a copy (do not redirect-and-delete) so your inbox keeps the original.

test.title: Send a test
test.body: Email your support address from a personal account. The message appears under Conversations as an email conversation and the AI replies to you by email.

confirmation.title: Gmail confirmation code
confirmation.waiting: Waiting for Google's confirmation email… It arrives here as soon as you add the forwarding address in Gmail.
confirmation.noCode: Hay.chat received Google's message but could not read the code. Open the link below instead.
